scope: Standalone six-camera GlFramePose; stable optical geometry unchanged; selected INI mounting yaw only.

vector_generation.source: Compiled MSVC original C++ FRAME oracle for enabled cases; exact static bypass for disabled cases.

assertions: All six signed16 camera roll/pitch results match compiled C while enabled.
Disabled returns captured static trims bit-for-bit; applied pose is zero.
All control, live pose and static trim inputs frozen at accepted start.
Results, applied pose and flags publish atomically only with one-cycle done.
Synchronous reset aborts during child normalization, later camera, scaler and recomputed pass.
Runtime EO/IR selection, 390-degree IR yaw, limit and sign/extreme values covered.

synthesis.executed_command: vivado -mode batch -notrace -source synth_check.tcl -log synth.log -journal synth.jou (cwd builds/frame_pose)
synthesis.reproduction_note: Checked-in script uses the same read/synth/report/checkpoint commands and source/ROM arguments as executed temporary script. Clock period is stated as 4.292 ns, the effective rounded value in the recorded run.
limitations: Unplaced post-synthesis estimate only; no routed timing closure.
Input/output delays are absent for this standalone construct check.
HD.CLK_SRC is unset, so out-of-context clock skew is an estimate.

independent_review.frame_pose_result: No arithmetic or handshake defects found. Signed numerator, divider widths, one-pass scaling, camera sequencing and atomic commit reviewed.

lease_review.result: No functional defect found in inspected GlLeasePose and top integration.
checks: History captures next epoch on the edge publishing the same Gray-coded global epoch.
Selected EO/IR lease epoch chooses its retained pose/control/revision snapshot.
Copy start waits for pose ready; renderer accepts frozen angles without frames_valid startup dependency.
Lease or mode changes cancel in-flight child work outside a pass; active render freezes results.
Missing/stale/disabled/calibration mismatch uses exact static bypass.
limits: Baseline queued-trigger epoch association does not establish measured camera exposure timing; IR uses the shared trigger epoch.
Both EO/IR update counters form calibration revision; changing the unused sensor trims also triggers mismatch fallback.
Callers must not retain an ambiguous epoch request across the complete 16-bit wrap.

capture_envelope.result: Reproduced report JSON identically; no discrepancy against RpSegXform/RpTables/RpRenderer guards.

route_guard_observation.conclusion: Route guard must require PLACED_FULLY plus ROUTED_FULLY and absence of ERRORS_IN_ROUTES.

timing_audit_smoke.local_command: vivado -mode batch -notrace -source audit_proc_smoke.tcl -log audit_proc_smoke.log -journal audit_proc_smoke.jou (cwd builds/frame_pose)
timing_audit_smoke.scope_limit: Internal GlLeasePose sequential paths only; existing external I/O and CDC constraints are audited separately.
